chain.title: Choose the Colony's Site
chain.desc: Place a Supply Camp on suitable ground. Its starting supplies help establish your settlement.

chain.title: Found a New Colony
chain.desc: Place the Town Hall using the Build Tool, then create your colony. Reserve room for expansion.

chain.title: Your First Building Crew
chain.desc: Place the Builder's Hut and request construction. Supply its worker with the requested materials and tools.

chain.title: Finish the Builder's Hut
chain.desc: Let the builder finish the first hut. Check that it is operational, then confirm this milestone.

chain.title: A Place for New Arrivals
chain.desc: Build a Tavern for the early settlement. Keep access clear and provide food while planning permanent homes.

chain.title: Homes for the Workforce
chain.desc: Construct a Residence and assign housing. More workers need suitable homes as well as jobs.

chain.title: Keep Timber Coming
chain.desc: Establish a Forester's Hut with tools and accessible trees. It begins the building-material supply branch.

chain.title: Materials from Below
chain.desc: Build a Mine, supply its requests and allow room for excavation. Check worker messages if production stops.

chain.title: Food for the Settlement
chain.desc: Build a Farmer's Hut and prepare nearby fields. Set crops and provide tools before expecting harvests.

chain.title: Assign the Crop Fields
chain.desc: Place field blocks and configure the crop assignments. Confirm the farmer can reach the plots.

chain.title: Feed the Workers
chain.desc: Build the food-service building available in this version. Stock its requested food so citizens can eat.

chain.title: One Place for Shared Supplies
chain.desc: Construct the Warehouse and supply its racks. Citizens need the courier network to move materials between workplaces.

chain.title: Connect the Workplaces
chain.desc: Build a Courier's Hut and employ its worker. Couriers collect products and fulfill workplace requests through the Warehouse.

chain.title: Watch a Request Arrive
chain.desc: Place building materials in the Warehouse and watch a courier deliver an actual worker request. Confirm after the delivery succeeds.

chain.title: Protect the Growing Town
chain.desc: Construct a Guard Tower and equip the guard. Position defenses to cover important paths and workplaces.

chain.title: Research the Next Chapter
chain.desc: Construct a University and employ researchers. Research requires its listed colony conditions, resources and time.

chain.title: Turn Resources into Knowledge
chain.desc: Complete a useful University research, meeting its displayed building and resource requirements. Confirm after the research finishes.

chain.title: A Colony That Supports Its Builders
chain.desc: Run the food, timber, mining and delivery branches together while a builder completes an upgrade. Confirm when the colony supplies meaningful parts of that project itself.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: First settlement, food and housing, builder supply, warehouse delivery, research and colony self-sufficiency.
coverage.limitations: Official MineColonies documentation reviewed; no local matching JAR was available. Hut item tasks measure obtaining the block, not constructing the building. Manual milestones explicitly confirm construction, delivery and research.
coverage.verification_detail: Every guide item and mod-specific check icon has a model in the official version source tree. Mechanics use official documentation; no local installation or playthrough was verified.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
verified_against: Official release/1.20 source assets (b6987ade75e7); no installed JAR verified
